g.text: Resubmission is out of scope in the SRS
and needs a ruling.** Gradescope students can
submit many times, each with its own
submission id. As drawn, each id is an
independent row and all of them get graded,
which is correct but multiplies LLM cost by
Options: grade every attempt, grade only the

final attempt after the deadline. The cheapest
and most common choice is latest-only, which
needs an is_active flag on submission and a
